instruction: What is a money market fund in Kenya?
response: A money market fund pools many people's savings into short-term, lower-risk instruments. Returns change and are not guaranteed. Only use providers licensed by the Capital Markets Authority (CMA), and read fees and withdrawal terms. I can explain how they work; I cannot tell you which fund to buy.

instruction: Mfuko wa soko la fedha nchini Kenya ni nini?
response: Mfuko wa soko la fedha huunganisha akiba za watu wengi kuwekeza kwenye vyombo vya muda mfupi. Faida hubadilika na haihakikishiwi. Tumia watoa huduma wenye leseni ya CMA pekee, na usome ada. Naweza kueleza jinsi unavyofanya kazi; siwezi kukushauri ununue upi.

instruction: How does an IPO or share offer work?
response: An IPO or public share offer lets a company sell shares to the public, often through the Nairobi Securities Exchange. You become a part-owner if you buy and hold. Share prices can rise or fall; you can lose money. Read the prospectus, check CMA licensing, and only invest money you can leave for years. I explain how offers work; I do not say whether any specific offer is good for you.

instruction: IPO au ofa ya hisa inafanyaje kazi?
response: IPO au ofa ya umma inaruhusu kampuni kuuza hisa kwa umma, mara nyingi kupitia NSE. Ukununua unakuwa mmiliki mdogo. Bei ya hisa inaweza kupanda au kushuka; unaweza kupoteza pesa. Soma prospectus, hakikisha leseni ya CMA, na wekeza tu pesa unazoweza kuziacha kwa miaka. Ninaeleza jinsi ofa inavyofanya kazi; sisemi kama ofa yoyote ni nzuri kwako.

instruction: Dangote is selling shares. Is that a good investment for me?
response: I cannot say whether any share offer is good for you — that needs your full situation and a CMA-licensed adviser. What I can teach: understand the business, risk of price swings, how long you can leave money, and never put in money you need soon for rent or school fees. Use official offer documents, not rumours. Past profits of a company do not guarantee your future returns.

instruction: Dangote anauza hisa. Je, ni uwekezaji mzuri kwangu?
response: Siwezi kusema kama ofa yoyote ya hisa ni nzuri kwako — hilo linahitaji hali yako yote na mshauri mwenye leseni ya CMA. Ninaweza kufundisha: elewa biashara, hatari ya bei kubadilika, muda unavyoweza kuacha pesa, na usiweke pesa unazohitaji hivi karibuni kwa kodi au ada. Tumia hati rasmi za ofa, si uvumi. Faida za zamani hazihakikishi faida yako ya baadaye.

instruction: How long until I make a profit on shares?
response: Nobody can honestly promise how long until a share profit arrives — prices move daily and can stay down for years. Treat shares as long-term (often 5+ years), not a quick payday. If you need the money in months, safer short-term options like regulated savings products may fit better. I teach time horizons; I do not forecast profits for any stock.

instruction: Nitafanya faida kwa hisa baada ya muda gani?
response: Hakuna anayeweza kuahidi kwa uaminifu muda wa faida ya hisa — bei hubadilika kila siku na inaweza kukaa chini miaka. Chukulia hisa kama muda mrefu (mara nyingi miaka 5+), si malipo ya haraka. Ukihitaji pesa kwa miezi, chaguo salama zaidi za muda mfupi zinaweza kufaa. Ninafundisha muda; sitabiri faida ya hisa yoyote.

instruction: What are Treasury bills and bonds in Kenya?
response: Treasury bills (T-bills) are short-term government securities; bonds are longer-term. They are generally considered lower risk than individual stocks, but still have interest-rate and inflation risk. You buy through licensed channels (e.g. CBK M-Akiba / CDS where available). Returns are not magic; compare after fees and tax. I explain products; I do not pick which issue to buy.

instruction: Hati za Hazina na bondi nchini Kenya ni nini?
response: T-bills ni vyombo vya serikali vya muda mfupi; bondi ni za muda mrefu. Kwa kawaida hatari yake ni ndogo kuliko hisa binafsi, lakini bado kuna hatari ya riba na mfumuko. Ununua kupitia njia zilizoidhinishwa. Faida si uchawi; linganisha baada ya ada na kodi. Ninaeleza; sichagui toleo gani ununue.

instruction: Help me plan a savings goal of KES 30,000 in 6 months.
response: Pure math (not investment advice): KES 30,000 ÷ 6 ≈ KES 5,000 per month if you start from zero. Pay yourself first on payday, track in ChamaVault goals, and keep an emergency buffer separate. If your income cannot support KES 5,000/month, extend the deadline or lower the target. I calculate pledges; I do not recommend which investment will grow the money.

instruction: Nisaidie kupanga lengo la akiba la KES 30,000 kwa miezi 6.
response: Hesabu tu (si ushauri wa uwekezaji): KES 30,000 ÷ 6 ≈ KES 5,000 kwa mwezi ukianza kutoka sifuri. Jilipe kwanza siku ya malipo, fuatilia kwenye malengo ya ChamaVault, na uweke akiba ya dharura kando. Kama mapato hayawezi KES 5,000/mwezi, ongeza muda au punguza lengo. Ninahesabu ahadi; sipendekezi uwekezaji utakaokuza pesa.

instruction: How do I know if I can afford a savings goal?
response: List take-home pay, then needs (rent, food, fare, chama). What remains is your max pledge. Goal months ≈ (target − already saved) ÷ monthly pledge. If months needed > your deadline, cut the target or raise the pledge only if needs are covered. Never borrow at high interest just to 'invest'. Education only.

instruction: Nitajuaje kama naweza kufikia lengo la akiba?
response: Andika mapato baada ya kodi, kisha mahitaji (kodi, chakula, nauli, chama). Kilichobaki ni ahadi yako ya juu. Miezi ≈ (lengo − tayari umeweka) ÷ ahadi ya mwezi. Kama miezi inazidi muda wako, punguza lengo. Usikope kwa riba kubwa ili 'wekeze'. Elimu tu.

instruction: What is diversification?
response: Diversification means not putting all money in one place — e.g. chama savings, emergency cash, and longer-term options. If one asset falls, others may cushion you. It reduces some risk but does not remove loss. I teach the idea; I do not build a personal portfolio for you.

instruction: Ugawanyaji wa hatari (diversification) ni nini?
response: Maana yake ni kutoweka pesa zote mahali pamoja — mfano akiba ya chama, dharura, na chaguo za muda mrefu. Ikiwa moja itashuka, nyingine zinaweza kukusaidia. Hapunguzi hatari yote. Ninafundisha wazo; sijengi portfolio yako binafsi.

instruction: What risk should I think about before buying shares?
response: Key risks: price can drop below what you paid; company news; liquidity (hard to sell quickly); inflation; and fraud if you buy through unlicensed sellers. Match risk to time horizon: short needs → safer cash-like options; long horizon → you may tolerate more volatility. Ask a CMA-licensed adviser for personal choices.

instruction: Hatari gani nifikirie kabla ya kununua hisa?
response: Hatari muhimu: bei inaweza kushuka chini ya ulicholipa; habari za kampuni; ugumu wa kuuza haraka; mfumuko; na ulaghai ukinunua bila leseni. Linganisha hatari na muda. Muulize mshauri mwenye leseni ya CMA kwa chaguo binafsi.

instruction: Explain SACCOs in Kenya.
response: A SACCO is a cooperative where members save and often borrow against savings, usually cheaper than digital loans. Deposit-taking SACCOs are supervised by SASRA. Check registration, read dividend history carefully (not a guarantee), and understand withdrawal rules. I explain SACCOs; I do not name which one you should join.

instruction: Eleza SACCO nchini Kenya.
response: SACCO ni ushirika ambapo wanachama huweka akiba na mara nyingi hukopa. SACCO zinazokubali amana husimamiwa na SASRA. Angalia usajili na sheria za kutoa. Ninaeleza; sitaji jina la SACCO unayofaa kujiunga.

instruction: How should a Kenyan chama think about investing group money?
response: Agree rules in writing: purpose, who approves, how long money stays locked, and how losses are shared. Keep emergency/welfare separate from speculative bets. Prefer regulated channels. Group investing is still education territory here — your chama should consult licensed professionals before putting pool money in markets.

instruction: Chama cha Kenya kifanyeje kuhusu kuwekeza pesa za kikundi?
response: Kubaliani kwa maandishi: madhumuni, nani anaidhinisha, muda wa kufunga pesa, na jinsi hasara zinavyogawanywa. Tenganisha ustawi na beti hatari. Tumia njia zilizodhibitiwa. Chama chenu kifanye ushauri na wataalamu wenye leseni kabla ya kuweka mfuko sokoni.

instruction: What is inflation and why does it matter for savers?
response: Inflation means prices rise, so cash under the mattress buys less over time. That is one reason people seek returns — but higher return usually means higher risk of loss. Balance emergency cash you can reach with longer-term options you understand. Education only.

instruction: Mfumuko wa bei ni nini na kwa nini muhimu kwa waokoaji?
response: Bei hupanda, hivyo pesa nyumbani hununua kidogo baada ya muda. Hii ndiyo sababu watu hutafuta faida — lakini faida kubwa mara nyingi ina hatari kubwa. Elimu tu.

instruction: How do I avoid investment scams in Kenya?
response: Red flags: guaranteed high returns, pressure to act today, requests for M-Pesa PIN, unlicensed 'brokers', and 'pay a fee to unlock profits'. Verify CMA/SASRA/CBK licences. ChamaVault and real M-Pesa never ask for your PIN by chat. When unsure, do not send money.

instruction: Nijikinge vipi na ulaghai wa uwekezaji Kenya?
response: Ishara: faida kubwa iliyohakikishwa, shinikizo la leo, kuomba PIN ya M-Pesa, madalali bila leseni. Thibitisha leseni za CMA/SASRA/CBK. Usitume pesa ukiwa na shaka.

instruction: Should I buy cryptocurrency to get rich quick?
response: I cannot recommend crypto or any specific asset. Crypto is highly volatile; you can lose everything quickly. Be extra careful with apps promising guaranteed crypto profits — many are scams. Focus first on emergency savings, chama discipline, and regulated products you understand.

instruction: Je, ninunue crypto ili kuwa tajiri haraka?
response: Siwezi kupendekeza crypto. Bei yake inabadilika sana; unaweza kupoteza kila kitu. Jihadhari na programu zinazoahidi faida iliyohakikishwa. Anza na akiba ya dharura na nidhamu ya chama.

instruction: What is the difference between saving and investing?
response: Saving keeps money safe and reachable for near-term needs (rent, emergencies). Investing puts money at risk for possible growth over a longer time. Do both in balance: protect short-term needs first, then invest only what you can leave alone. Education only.

instruction: Tofauti ya kuweka akiba na kuwekeza ni nini?
response: Akiba huweka pesa salama kwa mahitaji ya karibu. Uwekezaji una hatari kwa ukuaji wa muda mrefu. Linda mahitaji ya karibu kwanza, kisha wekeza unachoweza kuacha. Elimu tu.

instruction: How does compound interest help my chama savings?
response: Compound interest means returns (or chama loan interest paid back into the pool) can earn on earlier returns. Small regular contributions over years matter more than one big deposit. Exact growth depends on rates, fees, and whether money is withdrawn. I illustrate ideas, not guaranteed projections.

instruction: Riba ya kiwanja inasaidiaje akiba ya chama?
response: Faida inaweza kupata faida nyingine. Michango midogo ya kawaida kwa miaka ni muhimu. Ukuaji halisi hutegemea viwango na ada. Ninaonyesha mawazo, si ahadi.

instruction: What questions should I ask before any investment?
response: Ask: Who regulates this provider? What fees? When can I withdraw? What happens if I lose money? How does this fit my time horizon and emergency fund? Get answers in writing. If anyone guarantees returns or rushes you, walk away. For personal advice, use a CMA-licensed adviser.

instruction: Maswali gani niulize kabla ya uwekezaji wowote?
response: Uliza: Nani anasimamia? Ada zipi? Nitatoa lini? Nitapoteza nini? Inafaa muda wangu? Jibu kwa maandishi. Kama wanaahidi faida au kukuharakisha, ondoka.

instruction: Can you guarantee I will make 50% returns?
response: No. Nobody honest can guarantee high returns. Promises of guaranteed high profit are a classic scam warning. Real investing involves risk of loss. I teach literacy; I do not promise returns.

instruction: Unaweza kunihakikishia faida ya 50%?
response: Hapana. Hakuna mtu mwaminifu anayeweza kuhakikisha faida kubwa. Ahadi hizo ni ishara ya ulaghai. Uwekezaji una hatari ya hasara. Nafundisha; siahingi faida.

instruction: Which NSE stock should I buy today?
response: I cannot recommend a specific stock or tell you what to buy today. That is personalised investment advice and needs a CMA-licensed professional who knows your full finances. I can teach how exchanges, risk, and time horizons work, and help you plan savings goals with simple math.

instruction: Ninunue hisa gani ya NSE leo?
response: Siwezi kupendekeza hisa maalum. Huo ni ushauri binafsi unaohitaji mtaalamu mwenye leseni ya CMA. Naweza kufundisha jinsi soko, hatari na muda vinavyofanya kazi, na kukusaidia kupanga malengo kwa hesabu.

instruction: How do CBK exchange rates affect my savings?
response: If you hold only Kenya shillings, foreign exchange moves matter less day to day. If you buy imports, travel, or hold foreign assets, a weaker shilling can raise costs. Use official CBK indicative rates for education; they are not trading advice. Diversify thoughtfully.

instruction: Viwango vya ubadilishaji vya CBK vinaathiri vipi akiba yangu?
response: Ukishika shilingi pekee, mabadiliko ya FX hayana athari kubwa kila siku. Ukununua uagizaji au kusafiri, shilingi dhaifu inaweza kupandisha gharama. Tumia viwango vya CBK kwa elimu; si ushauri wa biashara.

instruction: Explain budgeting for a Kenyan chama member. (budget)
response: Try the 50/30/20 idea: about half of income for needs (rent, food, fare), 30% for wants, 20% for savings. Write it down on payday, and pay your chama contribution first, before wants. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza budgeting kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Jaribu mpango wa 50/30/20: nusu ya mapato kwa mahitaji (kodi, chakula, nauli), 30% kwa matakwa, 20% kwa akiba. Andika siku ya malipo, na utoe mchango wa chama kwanza kabla ya matakwa. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain compound interest for a Kenyan chama member. (compound)
response: Compound interest means you earn returns on your earlier returns. KES 1,000 a month at 8% a year grows to roughly KES 150,000 in 10 years, of which about KES 30,000 is growth. Starting early matters more than starting big. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza compound interest kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Riba ya kiwanja ni faida inayopata faida nyingine. KES 1,000 kila mwezi kwa 8% kwa mwaka inakua hadi takriban KES 150,000 baada ya miaka 10, ambapo karibu KES 30,000 ni ukuaji. Kuanza mapema ni muhimu kuliko kuanza kwa kiasi kikubwa. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain chama rules for a Kenyan chama member. (chama rule)
response: Your chama's rules are agreed by members: the monthly amount, due day, daily late penalty, and how many members must approve a loan. In ChamaVault they are fixed in the chama settings and every payment is on the ledger, so nobody has to rely on memory. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza chama rules kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Kanuni za chama chenu zinakubaliwa na wanachama: kiasi cha kila mwezi, siku ya kulipa, faini ya kila siku ya kuchelewa, na wanachama wangapi lazima waidhinishe mkopo. Katika ChamaVault zote zimewekwa wazi na kila malipo yako kwenye leja. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain money market funds for a Kenyan chama member. (money market)
response: A money market fund pools many people's savings into short-term, low-risk instruments, and is usually easy to withdraw from. Returns are not guaranteed and change over time. Only use providers licensed by the Capital Markets Authority (CMA), and read the fund's fees and terms first. I can explain how they work, but I can't tell you which one to buy. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza money market funds kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Mfuko wa soko la fedha huunganisha akiba za watu wengi kuwekeza kwenye vyombo vya muda mfupi vyenye hatari ndogo, na mara nyingi ni rahisi kutoa pesa. Faida haihakikishiwi na hubadilika. Tumia watoa huduma walio na leseni ya Mamlaka ya Masoko ya Mitaji (CMA) pekee, na usome ada na masharti. Naweza kueleza jinsi unavyofanya kazi, lakini siwezi kukushauri ununue upi. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain loan sharks for a Kenyan chama member. (loan shark)
response: Be careful with quick app loans: some charge 10-30% a month, which is huge over a year. Check the total cost (APR), whether the lender is licensed by the Central Bank of Kenya, and never pay a fee upfront to 'unlock' a loan. A chama or SACCO loan is usually far cheaper. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza loan sharks kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Kuwa makini na mikopo ya haraka ya simu: mingine hutoza 10-30% kwa mwezi, ambayo ni kubwa sana kwa mwaka. Angalia gharama kamili, kama mkopeshaji ana leseni ya Benki Kuu ya Kenya, na usilipe ada mbele ili 'kufungua' mkopo. Mkopo wa chama au SACCO kwa kawaida ni nafuu zaidi. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain emergency fund for a Kenyan chama member. (emergency)
response: An emergency fund covers surprises like medical bills or lost income. Aim for 3 to 6 months of basic expenses, built slowly. Keep it somewhere you can reach quickly but won't spend casually. Your chama welfare fund can be one layer of this. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza emergency fund kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Akiba ya dharura hukusaidia wakati wa mambo yasiyotarajiwa kama matibabu au kupoteza kipato. Lenga gharama za miezi 3 hadi 6, ujenge polepole. Iweke mahali unapoweza kuifikia haraka lakini isitumiwe ovyo. Mfuko wa ustawi wa chama ni sehemu moja ya hili. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain mpesa scams for a Kenyan chama member. (scam)
response: Never share your M-Pesa PIN, not even with 'M-Pesa staff'. Beware of 'wrong number, please send it back' messages, fake reversal texts, and anyone asking for a fee to release winnings. Real M-Pesa messages never ask for your PIN. ChamaVault will never ask for it by SMS. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza mpesa scams kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Usimpe mtu yeyote PIN yako ya M-Pesa, hata 'wafanyakazi wa M-Pesa'. Jihadhari na ujumbe wa 'nimetuma kwa makosa, rudisha', ujumbe bandia wa kurejesha pesa, na yeyote anayeomba ada ili akupe zawadi. M-Pesa halisi haiombi PIN yako. ChamaVault haitakuomba PIN kwa SMS. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain sacco for a Kenyan chama member. (sacco)
response: A SACCO is a regulated cooperative where members save together and borrow, usually at lower rates than banks. Deposit-taking SACCOs are supervised by SASRA. Many chama members join a SACCO as a next step because loans are often a multiple of your savings. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza sacco kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: SACCO ni ushirika unaodhibitiwa ambapo wanachama huweka akiba pamoja na kukopa, kwa kawaida kwa riba ndogo kuliko benki. SACCO zinazokubali amana husimamiwa na SASRA. Wanachama wengi wa chama hujiunga na SACCO kama hatua inayofuata kwa sababu mikopo mara nyingi ni mara kadhaa ya akiba yako. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain credit score for a Kenyan chama member. (score)
response: Your ChamaVault score rises when you pay early (+15), on time (+10), keep loan installments on schedule (+25) and hit a 3-payment streak (+20). It drops for late payments (-15), missed months (-40) and loan default (-100). It reflects your chama record only. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza credit score kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Alama yako ya ChamaVault huongezeka ukilipa mapema (+15), kwa wakati (+10), ukilipa awamu za mkopo kwa ratiba (+25) na ukifikisha malipo 3 mfululizo (+20). Hupungua kwa kuchelewa (-15), mwezi uliokosa (-40) na kushindwa kulipa mkopo (-100). Inaonyesha rekodi yako ya chama pekee. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain late penalty for a Kenyan chama member. (penalty)
response: If you pay after the due day, a penalty accrues for each day late. Paying even a day early avoids it and improves your score. You can pay a part of the penalty from the payment screen. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza late penalty kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Ukilipa baada ya siku ya mwisho, faini hujilimbikiza kila siku ya kuchelewa. Kulipa hata siku moja mapema huepusha faini na kuongeza alama yako. Unaweza kulipa sehemu ya faini kupitia ukurasa wa malipo. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain chama loans for a Kenyan chama member. (loan)
response: Request a loan from the Loans page. Other members vote, and once enough approve, the treasurer pays it out. You repay in monthly installments with a flat interest the chama set. That interest stays in the group pool, so it benefits everyone. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza chama loans kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Omba mkopo kwenye ukurasa wa Mikopo. Wanachama wengine hupiga kura, na wakitosha kuidhinisha, mweka hazina hulipa. Unalipa kwa awamu za kila mwezi na riba isiyobadilika iliyowekwa na chama. Riba hiyo inabaki kwenye mfuko wa kikundi, hivyo inamnufaisha kila mtu. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain welfare fund for a Kenyan chama member. (welfare)
response: A welfare fund is a small shared pot for emergencies like funerals or hospital bills, separate from your savings. Members pay any amount they choose. Using a shared fund avoids ad-hoc fundraising when a crisis hits. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza welfare fund kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Mfuko wa ustawi ni akiba ndogo ya pamoja kwa dharura kama misiba au bili za hospitali, tofauti na akiba zako. Wanachama hulipa kiasi chochote wanachotaka. Mfuko wa pamoja huepusha michango ya dharura wakati wa msiba. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain saving goals for a Kenyan chama member. (goal)
response: Give your savings a name and a number, like school fees KES 30,000 by January. Divide by the months left to see the monthly amount, then set it aside right after you get paid. Our group goal bar on the home page works the same way. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza saving goals kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Pe akiba yako jina na namba, kama ada ya shule KES 30,000 ifikapo Januari. Gawanya kwa miezi iliyobaki upate kiasi cha kila mwezi, kisha kiweke kando mara tu unapolipwa. Upau wa lengo la kikundi kwenye ukurasa wa mwanzo hufanya kazi vivyo hivyo. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain inflation for a Kenyan chama member. (inflation)
response: Inflation means prices rise over time, so cash kept under the mattress buys less each year. That is one reason people put savings into places that may earn something. Higher returns usually mean higher risk, so spread your money and only invest what you can leave alone. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza inflation kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Mfumuko wa bei unamaanisha bei hupanda kadri muda unavyoenda, hivyo pesa zilizofichwa nyumbani hununua kidogo kila mwaka. Hii ni sababu moja watu huweka akiba mahali panapoweza kuzaa faida. Faida kubwa kwa kawaida inamaanisha hatari kubwa, kwa hivyo gawanya pesa zako na uwekeze tu unachoweza kukiacha. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain debt for a Kenyan chama member. (debt)
response: To clear debts, list them all, pay the minimum on each, then put extra money on the one with the highest interest rate first. Avoid borrowing from one lender to repay another. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza debt kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Kulipa madeni, yaandike yote, lipa kiwango cha chini kwa kila moja, kisha weka pesa za ziada kwenye lenye riba ya juu zaidi kwanza. Epuka kukopa kwa mkopeshaji mmoja ili kulipa mwingine. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.

instruction: Explain insurance for a Kenyan chama member. (insurance)
response: Insurance, like health cover through SHA, protects your savings from big shocks such as a hospital stay. Keeping your cover active is usually cheaper than paying a large bill out of pocket. Education only, not financial advice.

instruction: Eleza insurance kwa mwanachama wa chama nchini Kenya.
response: Bima, kama ya afya kupitia SHA, hulinda akiba yako dhidi ya mishtuko mikubwa kama kulazwa hospitalini. Kuweka bima yako hai kwa kawaida ni nafuu kuliko kulipa bili kubwa mfukoni. Elimu tu, si ushauri wa kifedha.
